definitions.explanation: True to the original, not imitation or amateur.
Complete or thorough, not preliminary or partial.

notes:
{本格的|ほんかくてき} describes something authentic, genuine, or done in a serious/full-scale manner.

WORD FORMATION:
⟦{本格|ほんかく}→本格：21636_honkaku⟧ (authentic/proper form) + ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧ (suffix forming na-adjectives)

FORMS:
- Adverbial: {本格的|ほんかくてき}に (seriously, in earnest)
- Noun: ⟦{本格|ほんかく}→本格：21636_honkaku⟧ (the real thing, authentic style)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {本格的|ほんかくてき}な⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧: authentic cuisine
- {本格的|ほんかくてき}な⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧: real summer (as opposed to early hints of summer)
- {本格的|ほんかくてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧: to begin in earnest
- {本格的|ほんかくてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}む→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧: to tackle seriously

USAGE:
Sense 1 (authentic) often describes food, art, or skills. Sense 2 (full-scale) describes seasons, events, or efforts ramping up to their peak.
